I · The Cave

A place to retreat

Hira is the name of the cave high above Mecca where the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, used to retreat to meditate, long before revelation found him there. It was his refuge from the buzz of Mecca below.

Hira, high above the hills of Los Angeles, and at the threshold of the Angeles National Forest, is conceived as just such a cocoon: a place for the treasures of consciousness to surface in silence, contemplation, and slow, unfolding, calm days.

Elevation: 2,100 ft

Astralab 1.0 closed its doors in the Granada Buildings with one final gathering: half our belongings in suitcases, gratitude overflowing, and a promise made that night for what would come next. A place for artists to be, away from the city, closer to the earth. This is that promise.

IV · The Earth

Earthbuilding

A technique created by the honoured and respected architect Nader Khalili; I first learned of SuperAdobe Earthbag building from my Quran teacher (also a working architect who was a student of Khalili, and who I had the honour of meeting on one of my trips to Granada, Spain in the early 2000s)…

V · The Possibilities

What Hira will be

01

The Outside-In Land

A visionary escape & inner journey: soft Korean grass underfoot, outdoor walls of billowing silken fabrics, & a linen shade in the sky that ripples like an ocean above an outdoor lounge. Land as art.

02

Spiritually Informed Coaching

One-to-one sessions drawing upon twenty years of Sufi wisdom & Creativity. The world is pushing therapy hard, however its grounding is based largely on outdated European paradigms that can be incredibly problematic for people of faith. Sufi psychology is holistic, inclusive of family, does not shy away from accountability, & offers creative ways of seeing & working through issues.

03

The Astralab Podcast

Recorded in the Lapis Room, where the most interesting artists, thinkers & leaders of Los Angeles escape the city to engage in thoughtful, grounded conversations.

04

Artist Residencies

Twice a year, Summer & Winter. An artist or two have a week or two with the land all to themselves.

05

Unincorporated Coffee

We roast the most delicious coffee beans in Los Angeles &, perhaps you already know about our Crystal Chai..?

06

The Farm

Passion fruit, figs, roses, hibiscus, hens, eggs, an arched trellis path…

07

L.E.A.V.E.

An off-grid / “on again” school that teaches traditional building methods, farming & Sufi principles that reverse the off-grid mentality from its individualistic, subtraction mindset into one of harmony with society, integrating a visionary, new way of being.
